visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins inside a dark camping tent with a handheld perspective. A yellow inflatable sleeping pad is prominent on the floor, surrounded by various camping items, including a small fan, a camera lens, and bags. A man’s hand is seen adjusting a camera. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor view of a wide, calm lake under an overcast sky. A group of people is seen on the shore with colorful Stand-Up Paddleboards (SUP). Dense green trees frame the shot as the camera pans across the shoreline where several tents are pitched. (3) A male character in a grey jacket and black t-shirt speaks directly to the camera while walking through a wooded campsite. Another man in a blue shirt and hat walks behind him in the background. The lighting is natural and diffuse. (4) The camera moves into a bright, modern indoor bathroom facility. The interior features clean white walls, multiple toilet stalls with wooden doors, a large mirror, and several sinks. The lighting is bright studio-style artificial light. (5) Outdoor shots show a designated ash disposal area with metal buckets and a sign. This is followed by a shot of a large wooden cabin-style building with a sign that reads 'Raimujin no Ie'. (6) Close-up views of a pricing board show SUP rental and camping fees listed in Japanese Yen. The camera then focuses on a yellow and white Suzuki motorcycle parked in a gravel parking lot alongside several cars. (7) A fast-paced montage concludes the video, showing the men folding their tents, packing gear into bags, and preparing to depart. The visual rhythm accelerates significantly during this final sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an informative travel vlog intended to share practical details about camping at Lake Toya. It combines a first-person review of the campsite's facilities, such as the high-quality toilets and ash disposal, with specific pricing data for services like SUP and hot springs, aiming to provide a comprehensive guide for other campers or motorcycle tourers.
